script: cd /var/www/xinmo-site/tools/mc-derivative-pack && BASE='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/main/tools/mc-derivative-pack' && for f in index.html AI-GUIDE.md README.txt parts/parts-manifest.json; do curl -fsSL "$BASE/$f" -o "$f" || echo FAIL:/; done && for i in $(seq 1 20); do n=$(printf 'Derivative-Main-v4.zip.part%02d' $i); curl -fsSL "$BASE/parts/$n" -o "parts/$n" || echo FAIL:/; done && echo SYNC_DONE
